localizedValues.name: Standard Cabins - Beachfront
localizedValues.description:
Relax in 10 historic waterfront cabins at Cama Beach. Depending upon the tide, your rustic cabin is only a few yards from the ocean on Saratoga Passage. Built in the 1930s, each cabin has a full size bed in the bedroom and another in the living space. Cabins have heaters, hot and cold running water in the kitchen, refrigerators and microwaves. They have hotel quality beds but no bedding. Bring sleeping bags, pillows, and camp stove or propane barbecue for cooking outside, plus cooking utensils, plates and cups, towels, and toiletries. There are plenty of barbecue stands if you bring charcoal, kindling, and matches. (Leave slow cookers and electric frying pans at home.) There are no coffee makers in the cabins but you may bring one if you wish. Restroom with hot showers is nearby. Personal vehicles are not allowed in the cabin area. Carts and wagons are available for guests to bring their belongings from the parking areas to the cabins.
Group reservations of 7 or more cabins and/or day use facilities can be made up to 18 months in advance by calling Cama Beach State Park at 360-387-1550. Individual cabin bookings can be made online and through the reservation call center at nine months in advance.

localizedValues.name: Bungalows
localizedValues.description:
Built in the 1930s, the two large rustic bungalow cabins each sleep 8 and have an inside restroom with shower, toilet and sink. All cabins have heat, electricity, 2 tables, 8 chairs, hot/cold kitchen sink, 10 cu. ft refrigerator with freezer, 1 cu. ft microwave, 12 cup coffee maker with permanent filter. Beds have a decorative quilt which you may use. Guests bring bedding and kitchen items. No additional cooking indoors beyond the microwave. Camp stoves and propane grills ok for outdoor use as fire ban restrictions allow. A picnic table is outdoors for each cabin. Upright BBQ grills and 4 fire pits are shared among the cabin community. Personal vehicles are not allowed in the cabin area. Carts and wagons are available for guests to bring their belongings from the parking areas to the cabins.
Bungalow A: has a twin over full bunk-styled bed in each of the two bedrooms, also 2 single twins in the living space.
Bungalow H: Is ADA compliant with a twin over full bunk styled bed in the one bedroom, another bunk unit in the living space, plus a plain full in the living space. This cabin is configured for ADA needs with a ramp up the back of the cabin, a larger restroom with wheel-in shower, and support bars.
Group reservations of 7 or more cabins and/or day use facilities can be made up to 18 months in advance by calling Cama Beach State Park at 360-387-1550. Individual cabin bookings can be made online and through the reservation call center at nine months in advance.
